AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Authorized wholesaler admin UID record for zero-trust RBAC verification.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin.

email.description: Verified email address of the admin.

StoreSettings.title: StoreSettings
StoreSettings.description: Wholesaler public store settings used for WhatsApp order routing and branding.

showNewArrivals.description: Admin toggle to show or hide the New Arrivals section on the Buyer Home tab.

newArrivalsTitle.description: Custom heading for the Buyer Home New Arrivals section.

newArrivalsLimit.description: Maximum number of newly listed items shown in the Buyer Home carousel.

primaryColorHex.description: Admin-selected primary brand color hex code (#RRGGBB) applied across the app and buyer catalog.

BusinessProfile.title: BusinessProfile
BusinessProfile.description: Admin-only billing firm profile and atomic invoice counter (settings/businessProfile).

firmName.description: Legal wholesale firm name for invoices.

gstin.description: Optional GSTIN of the wholesaler firm.

upiId.description: Optional UPI ID printed on invoices for digital payments.

invoicePrefix.description: Prefix for sequential invoice numbers (default INV).

nextInvoiceNumber.description: Auto-incremented invoice counter updated inside a Firestore transaction.

lowStockThreshold.description: Minimum stock quantity threshold below which Admin Inventory triggers a Low Stock alert badge.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Registered wholesaler admin or shopkeeper buyer account.

fcmToken.description: Optional Firebase Cloud Messaging registration token for push notifications.

notifyOrderUpdates.description: Optional preference to receive instant order status update notifications.

notifyNewProducts.description: Optional preference to receive instant new wholesale product notifications.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Wholesale car accessory catalog item with pricing, MOQ, stock status, optional HSN/GST, and compressed photos.

stockQuantity.description: Optional current warehouse inventory quantity in pieces used for Low Stock monitoring.

newArrival.description: Optional admin-controlled flag to highlight this product in the Buyer Home New Arrivals section.

hsnCode.description: Optional HSN code for GST billing.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: B2B wholesale order placed by an approved shopkeeper.

invoiceId.description: Optional linked invoice document ID once billed.

stockDeducted.description: Optional flag indicating product stock quantities were deducted upon delivery or billing to prevent double deduction.

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: GST Tax Invoice or Estimate / Cash Memo with payment history and Udhaar tracking.

stockDeducted.description: Optional flag indicating catalog product stock quantities were deducted when generating this invoice.

NotificationEvent.title: NotificationEvent
NotificationEvent.description: FCM push dispatch and real-time shopkeeper notification event created by Admin on order status updates or new product listings.

targetUserId.description: Target shopkeeper UID for order status updates, or ALL_BUYERS for new product broadcasts.

targetTopic.description: FCM topic name (e.g. new_products or user_<uid>).

targetFcmToken.description: Optional recipient FCM device token snapshot for server-side FCM HTTP v1 delivery.

AdminActivityLog.title: AdminActivityLog
AdminActivityLog.description: Immutable, append-only admin audit log tracking critical actions such as product additions, wholesale price changes, shopkeeper approvals/blocks, order/billing actions, and theme/settings changes.

actorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who performed the action (must equal request.auth.uid).

actorEmail.description: Email address of the admin actor.

actorName.description: Display name of the admin actor.

targetId.description: Document ID of the affected product, user, order, invoice, or settings record.

targetName.description: Human-readable name of the affected entity.

summary.description: Concise human-readable description of the change.

previousValue.description: Previous state or price before the change (empty string if not applicable).

newValue.description: New state or price after the change (empty string if not applicable).

/settings/{settingId}.description: Wholesaler store (store) and billing firm profile (businessProfile).

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles for wholesaler admin and shopkeepers.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Wholesale orders placed by approved shopkeepers.

/invoices/{invoiceId}.description: GST tax invoices and cash memos with Udhaar payment tracking.

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: Admin-authored FCM notification events for order status changes and new product arrivals.

/activityLogs/{logId}.description: Immutable admin-only security & accountability audit trail.
